strategyPrimer:
Cut CardSuggested AddReasoning
RansackBartolomé del PresidioRansack is a blue card outside Abzan identity and likely an import mismatch for Ransack the Lab. Bartolomé del Presidio is a free sacrifice outlet that grows with +1/+1 counters every time it eats a creature, so each sacrifice of Young Wolf or Putrid Goblin also feeds Tayam's three-counter cost. EDHREC: 61% inclusion, +0.57 synergy.
Golgari BrownscaleAbigale, Eloquent First-YearGolgari Brownscale has no counter or sacrifice text and is likely an import mismatch for Golgari Rot Farm (a land; if so, restore the land and cut elsewhere). Abigale, Eloquent First-Year puts three keyword counters on a creature at MV 2, which is one full Tayam activation, and can also strip abilities from an opposing creature.
Commune with EvilHollowmurk SiegeCommune with Evil is likely an import mismatch for Commune with the Gods. Choosing Sultai on Hollowmurk Siege draws a card the first time each turn a counter lands on one of your creatures, and Tayam gives every creature a vigilance counter on entry.
Afterlife from the LoamFeast of the Victorious DeadAfterlife from the Loam is MV 8 and likely an import mismatch for Life from the Loam. Feast of the Victorious Dead converts each turn's deaths from Viscera Seer or Carrion Feeder into life and +1/+1 counters, which refills Tayam's counter pool.
Wickerbough ElderQasali PridemageSame artifact/enchantment removal job as Wickerbough Elder at MV 2 instead of 4, so Tayam can return it from the graveyard after each use, repeating the Haywire Mite / Cankerbloom pattern.
Armorcraft JudgeRavenous SquirrelArmorcraft Judge is MV 4 and can't be recurred by Tayam. Ravenous Squirrel is a 1-drop that grows on every sacrifice and is itself a sacrifice-to-draw outlet, giving the deck a repeatable draw engine alongside Skullclamp.
Hagra ConstrictorGood-Fortune UnicornHagra Constrictor mostly grants menace. Good-Fortune Unicorn adds a +1/+1 counter to every creature that enters, including each one Tayam returns, so every recursion refunds counters. It also stacks with Hardened Scales, Conclave Mentor and Winding Constrictor.
Solar ArrayPatrolling PeacemakerSolar Array's sunburst does nothing here. Patrolling Peacemaker enters with two +1/+1 counters (plus Tayam's vigilance counter, three in total) and proliferates whenever an opponent targets anyone, which adds to Evolution Sage's counter growth.
Card NameInclusion RankingSynergy & Rationale
Bartolomé del Presidio9Free outlet that grows a counter on every sacrifice. Redundant with Carrion Feeder, and both together turn Young Wolf, Strangleroot Geist, Putrid Goblin and Safehold Elite loops into steady Tayam fuel while triggering Zulaport Cutthroat, Blood Artist and Cruel Celebrant.
Abigale, Eloquent First-Year8Three counters for two mana, one full Tayam activation. Flexible: target your own blocker for keywords, or an opponent's key creature to remove its abilities.
Hammerhead, Maggia Boss8A third free counter-growing sacrifice outlet, which also eats Servos from Weaponcraft Enthusiast and Spawn from Basking Broodscale.
Devoted Druid7EDHREC's strongest Tayam signal (80% inclusion, +0.74 synergy), and it was in the 2026-09-18 list. It puts -1/-1 counters on itself, which Tayam can remove. EDHREC lists Tayam + Devoted Druid as a combo, so check it against the Bracket 2 rule on two-card combos before adding.
Hollowmurk Siege7Sultai mode: a once-per-turn draw whenever a counter is put on your creature. Tayam's vigilance counters, Rishkar, Peema Renegade and Abzan Ascendancy trigger it reliably.
Feast of the Victorious Dead7Turns aristocrat deaths into life and +1/+1 counters at end step, refilling counters spent on Tayam activations.
Good-Fortune Unicorn7Every entering creature, including Tayam returns, gets a +1/+1 counter, made larger by Hardened Scales, Conclave Mentor and Winding Constrictor.
Icatian Moneychanger7Enters with three credit counters, exactly one Tayam activation, at MV 1. It also deals 3 damage to you, which the deck's drain effects offset. EDHREC: 40% inclusion, +0.38 synergy.
Patrolling Peacemaker7Two +1/+1 counters plus Tayam's vigilance counter, with proliferate triggers that add to Evolution Sage and Cankerbloom.
Ravenous Squirrel7A 1-drop that grows on every sacrifice and is itself a draw outlet. Cheap redundancy for card advantage.
Qasali Pridemage6MV 2 recurrable artifact/enchantment removal, a cheaper version of Wickerbough Elder.
Warden of the Grove6Grows every end step and endures each nontoken creature that enters. EDHREC flags Carrion Feeder + Warden of the Grove as a combo, so check it against Bracket 2 before adding.
Promise of Bunrei6Four Spirit tokens when a creature dies: fodder for Viscera Seer and Priest of Forgotten Gods, and Tayam can recur it.
Felothar, Dawn of the Abzan6Sacrifice on enter or attack puts a +1/+1 counter on your whole team: counters and death triggers in one card.
Grist, the Hunger Tide6MV 3 planeswalker that Tayam can return. Makes Insect fodder and offers removal by sacrificing a creature.
Vraska Joins Up6A deathtouch counter on each creature you control, which is more Tayam fuel and a defensive board.
Mikey & Leo, Chaos & Order6Once-per-turn draw when you put a counter on your creature, triggered by Tayam entries and Rishkar, Peema Renegade.
Fain, the Broker6Converts sacrifices into counters and counters into Treasure, so it can also spend excess counters.
Insidious Fungus6MV 1 removal or a cantrip that Tayam can recur. Fits alongside Haywire Mite and Cankerbloom.
Cathar Commando6Flash, sacrifice to destroy an artifact or enchantment, recurrable with Tayam.
Dina, Soul Steeper6Every lifegain from Zulaport Cutthroat, Blood Artist, Cruel Celebrant or Bastion of Remembrance becomes extra drain.
Vampiric Rites6Repeatable draw sacrifice outlet; enchantment Tayam can recur.
Deadly Dispute6Card draw and a Treasure for one sacrifice, at instant speed.
Abrupt Decay5Efficient uncounterable removal; generic but on-color.
Heartless Act5Efficient removal; the counter-removal mode has little use here.
Sheoldred's Edict5Flexible edict; the deck already has several edict creatures, such as Plaguecrafter.
Master Chef5Other creatures enter with an extra +1/+1 counter while Tayam is out.
Resourceful Defense5Moves counters off dying creatures; minor value with undying and persist.
Mortician Beetle5Grows a counter on every sacrifice. Cheap counter fuel.
Lightless Evangel5Grows on each sacrifice of a creature or artifact.
Spike Feeder5Enters with counters; can move them or turn them into life.
Selfless Spirit5Team protection that is itself a sacrifice.
Shambling Shell5Recurring sacrifice outlet through dredge.
Evolution Witness5Adapt returns a permanent card to your hand.
Pawn of Ulamog5Makes Spawn fodder when nontoken creatures die.
Botanical Brawler5Grows when counters land elsewhere.
Unbreakable Formation5Protection against a board wipe, plus counters.
Breena, the Demagogue4Political counters and draw; off-plan.
Tireless Tracker4Card advantage, but without the deck's counter or death synergy.
Scavenging Ooze3Graveyard hate conflicts with Tayam's own graveyard.
All other pool cards1-3The rest of the roughly 1,000-card pool was not ranked individually; the pool is too large for one row per card. From a skim, most are generic +1/+1 counter or sacrifice cards that the existing outlets and engines already cover, cards that need a tribe the deck lacks, or cards that break the deck's no-library-search rule.
